P.name: Backstab
P.title: Template:Data Shaco/Backstab
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Backstab|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Shaco
|skill        = I
|icon         = Backstab.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Shaco}} basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} when hitting an enemy from behind.
|blurb2      = ''{{ai|Deceive|Shaco}}'' and ''{{ai|Two-Shiv Poison|Shaco}}'' have additional effects when they hit an enemy from behind. 
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Shaco's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{as|{{pp|20 + (35-25)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} when hitting an enemy from behind. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
|description2 = ''{{ai|Deceive|Shaco}}'' and ''{{ai|Two-Shiv Poison|Shaco}}'' have additional effects when they hit an enemy from behind. 
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = False
|spelleffects = basic
|parry        = True
|notes        = 
* ''Backstab's'' bonus damage adds to the damage instance of the original basic attack.
* The attacks do not deal the '''bonus''' damage against {{tip|structures}}.

}}

Q.name: Deceive
Q.title: Template:Data Shaco/Deceive
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Deceive|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Shaco
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Deceive.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Shaco}} becomes {{tip|invisible}} for a short time and {{tip|blinks}} to the target location.
|blurb2      = After breaking the invisibility, his next basic attack within a brief moment will deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
|blurb3      = {{sbc|{{ai|Backstab|Shaco}} Bonus:}} The attack will {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shaco''' becomes {{tip|invisible}} for a duration, and after a {{fd|0.125}}-second delay, he {{tip|blinks}} to the target location.
|leveling     = {{st|Invisibility Duration|{{ap|2.5 to 3.5}} seconds}}
|description2= ''Deceive's'' {{tip|invisibility}} breaks when '''Shaco''' uses a basic attack or casts ''{{ai|Two-Shiv Poison|Shaco}}'', but not from casting ''{{ai|Jack in the Box|Shaco}}'' or ''{{ai|Hallucinate|Shaco}}''.
|description3 = After breaking the invisibility, '''Shaco''' empowers his next basic attack within {{fd|0.25}} seconds to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, which is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
|leveling3    = {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|25 to 65}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description4 = {{sbc|{{ai|Backstab|Shaco}} Bonus:}} The attack will {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|160|60}}|critical damage}} damage, increased to {{as|{{critical damage|200|100}}|critical damage}} if a critical strike was {{tt|rolled|See notes}}.
|target range = 400
|cooldown     = {{ap|13 to 11}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cast time    = none
|cost         = 40
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Self
|grounded     = True
|damagetype   = physical
|parry = true
|spelleffects = basic
|outofrange   = cast at max
|notes        = 
* If the attack would have already {{tip|critical strike|critically struck}} based on '''Shaco's''' {{as|{{sti|critical strike chance}}}}, the base {{ai|Backstab|Shaco}} critical damage modifier will be overridden by the default critical damage modifier.
** {{iis|Sundered Sky}} {{nie|Lightshield Strike}} will '''not''' interact with this{{bug|2}}, but will be triggered as usual.
* ''Deceive's'' bonus damage adds directly to the damage instance of the basic attack.
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.
}}

W.name: Jack in the Box
W.title: Template:Data Shaco/Jack in the Box
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Jack in the Box|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Shaco
|skill        = W
|icon         = Jack in the Box.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Shaco}} summons a ''box'' at the target location that becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after a short time.
|blurb2      = The ''box'' will spring out upon enemy contact, {{tip|fearing}} nearby enemies for a short time. Enemy {{tip|champions}} hit are also briefly {{tip|root|rooted}}.
|blurb3      = The ''box'' will remain for a few seconds to automatically fire at nearby enemies, dealing {{as|magic damage}} that is increased when attacking only one enemy.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shaco''' summons a ''box'' at the target location that becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over 2 seconds, lasting for up to 40 {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} seconds. The ''box'' is {{tip|invulnerable}} and {{tip|untargetable}} to enemies while stealthed.
|description2 = The ''box'' will spring out upon enemy contact, {{tip|fearing}} nearby enemies for a duration, modified to {{fd|2.2}} seconds against non-champions, and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for a duration, modified to a 1 second root against non-champions. After a {{fd|0.15}}-second delay of the ''box's'' activation, enemies hit also have their {{sti|{{as|movement speed}}}} reduced. Enemy champions have their {{as|movement speed}} set to a {{as|static 100|ms}}, while non-champions are set to a {{as|static 60|ms}}. The {{as|movement speed}} reduction lasts for the same duration as the fear plus {{fd|0.3}} seconds.
|leveling2    = {{st|Fear Duration|{{ap|0.5 to 1.5}} seconds}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|0.5|0.75|1|1|1}} seconds}}
{{st|Slow Duration|{{ap|0.5+0.3 to 1.5+0.3}} seconds}}
|description3 = Once sprung, the ''box'' will remain for 5 seconds, during which it will automatically fire at nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} with each attack. If the ''box'' attacks only one target, it deals increased damage. ''Boxes'' deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to {{tip|monsters}} and 50% reduced damage to {{tip|turrets|structures}}.
|leveling3    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}}|Increased Damage|{{ap|25 to 85}} {{as|(+ 18% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Monster Damage|{{ap|20 to 80}}|Total Monster Damage|{{ap|10+20 to 30+80}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}}|Increased Monster Damage|{{ap|25+20 to 85+80}} {{as|(+ 18% AP)}}}}
|description4 = ''See [[Shaco#Pets|Pets]] for more details about boxes.''
|target range = 500
|customlabel  = Detection Radius
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|custominfo   = 300
|cooldown     = 15
|cost         = {{ap|70 to 50}}
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = true
|spelleffects = aoe
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|parry        = 
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* The root and fear are applied at the same time. The target cannot be forced to move by the fear during the root.
** The target is however allowed to move despite being rooted for the first {{fd|0.1}} seconds of the root. They can be forced to move by the fear during this time.
* The static movement speed modifier overrides the target's base movement speed value to the modified amount, and their bonus movement speed value to 0.
** The modifier is not applied if the target is {{tip|slow-immune}}.
* The box is {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|invulnerable}} so long as it is in {{tip|stealth}}. Effects that reveal {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed traps}} will render the box targetable and vulnerable while it can be seen.
}}

E.name: Two-Shiv Poison
E.title: Template:Data Shaco/Two-Shiv Poison
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Two-Shiv Poison|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Shaco
|skill        = E
|icon         = false
|icon2        = Two-Shiv Poison.png

|blurb2      = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shaco''' throws a dagger at the target enemy that {{tip|slows}} them for a short time, dealing {{as|magic damage}} that is increased if they are {{as|at low health}}.
|blurb3      = {{sbc|{{ai|Backstab|Shaco}} Bonus:}} The dagger deals additional {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Shaco's''' basic attacks {{tip|slow}} enemies for 2 seconds while ''Two-Shiv Poison'' is not on cooldown.
|leveling     = {{st|Slow|{{ap|20 to 30}}%}}
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shaco''' throws a dagger at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}, {{ccs|increased by 50%|magic}} if they are {{as|'''below''' 30% of their '''maximum''' health}}, and {{tip|slows}} them for 3 seconds.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 170}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}|Increased Damage|{{ap|70*1.5 to 170*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80*1.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*1.5}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|20 to 30}}%}}
|description3 = {{sbc|{{ai|Backstab|Shaco}} Bonus:}} The dagger deals an additional {{as|{{pp|15 + (50-15)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, increased to {{as|{{pp|15*1.5 + (50*1.5-15*1.5)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*1.5}}% AP)}} if the target is {{as|'''below''' 30% of their '''maximum''' health}}.
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 625
|cooldown     = 8
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|speed        = 1500

|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Spell
|projectile   = True
|notes        =
* '''Shaco''' replicates the last attack animation he performed for ''Two-Shiv Poison's'' animation.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
}}

R.name: Hallucinate
R.title: Template:Data Shaco/Hallucinate
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Hallucinate|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Shaco |skill = R |icon = Hallucinate.png |blurb = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Shaco}} briefly {{tip|vanishes}} and {{tip|blinks}} in the target direction, creating a {{tip|clone}} of himself for some time. |blurb2 = The clone will explode upon dying or expiring, which deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and deploys three {{ai|Jack in the Box|Shaco|mini-boxes}} that activate instantly, briefly {{tip|fearing}} nearby enemies. |blurb3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Shaco''' commands the clone to move to the target location. |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shaco''' {{tip|vanish|vanishes}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and {{tip|blinks}} in the {{tt|target direction|150 units}} while creating a {{tip|clone}} of himself that is summoned in the {{tt|opposite direction|150 units}}, remaining within {{tt|control range|1125 units}} of him as a controllable {{tip|clone}} for up to 18 seconds.

''Hallucinate'' can be recast at any time while the clone is alive, and can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. |icon2 = Hallucinate 2.png |description2 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Shaco''' commands the {{tip|clone}} to move to the target location. |description3 = The clone will explode upon dying or expiring to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and deploy three ''{{ai|Jack in the Box|Shaco|mini-boxes}}'' that activate instantly, {{tip|fearing}} nearby enemies for 1 second, increased to {{fd|2.2}} seconds against non-champions, and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, increased to {{tt|{{fd|0.6}} seconds|Estimated}} against monsters and {{tt|1 second|Estimated}} against minions. After a {{fd|0.15}}-second delay of the ''boxes' '' activation, enemies hit also have their {{as|movement speed}} reduced. Enemy champions have their {{as|movement speed}} set to a {{as|static 100|ms}}, while non-champions are set to a {{as|static 60|ms}}. The {{as|movement speed}} reduction lasts for the same duration as the fear plus {{fd|0.3}} seconds. |leveling3 = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 300}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}} |description4 = The ''boxes'' possess ''{{ais|Jack in the Box|Shaco}}'' effects, except they have a doubled, but shared {{sti|{{as|health}}}}, and deal {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}} with each attack, increased when attacking a single unit. They are also {{tip|invulnerable}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}|estimated}} seconds after deployment. |leveling4 = {{st|Modified Magic Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Increased Modified Damage|{{ap|25 to 75}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}}} |description5 = ''See [[Shaco#Pets|Pets]] for more details about '''Shaco's''' clone.'' |cooldown = {{ap|100 to 80}} |cdstart = on-cast |effect radius= {{tt|250|Detonation}} |cast time = {{fd|0.25}} |cost = 100 |costtype = Mana |targeting = [[Direction-targeted|Direction]] / [[Location-targeted|Location]] |affects = Self |damagetype = Magic |spellshield = True |spelleffects = Special |grounded = false |notes = * If the explosion hits at least one minion, the ''boxes'' will fear all enemies regardless of their unit type for {{fd|2.2}} seconds, causing enemy champions to be feared for the non-champion fear duration.{{bug}} * The root and fear are applied at the same time. The target cannot be forced to move by the fear during the root. ** The target is however allowed to move despite being rooted for the first {{fd|0.15}} seconds of the root. They can be forced to move by the fear during this time. * '''Shaco''' and the ''Hallucination'' will face each other the moment of their appearance. * The explosion and the ''boxes'' apply {{tip|area damage}}, while the clone deals {{tip|basic damage}}. * ''Hallucinate'' will cast from wherever '''Shaco''' is at the end of the cast time. * When '''Shaco''' dies, the clone will automatically target the closest visible enemy champion within 1500 units. * The clone will always spawn in the opposite direction of the cursor. ** If ''Deceive'' and ''Hallucinate'' are used in quick succession, the clone will spawn in the direction of the cursor instead. }}
